entities.summary: Sergei Viktorovich Shendelev is a retired ice hockey player who played in the Soviet Hockey League. He played for Traktor Chelyabinsk and SKA St. Petersburg. He was inducted into the Russian and Soviet Hockey Hall of Fame in 1993.
